description_expanded:
Watercolor’s Cottage District

1 mile to Beach Club with private beach access!

Full access to Dragonfly Pool, Camp Watercolor, private beach club, etc!

Explore Seaside, WaterColor, Seagrove, Alys and Rosemary Beach

Six-seater golf cart

4 bikes!

Gas grill

4-star restaurants

Cute boutiques

Blue Oyster Cottage by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Tucked in the Cottage District, Blue Oyster Cottage sits just behind the WaterColor Tennis Center, with Seaside Town Center only a quick five-minute walk away. Its prime location makes it easy to bike or stroll to Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club, offering a laid-back beach escape with a splash of luxury. Very nice! The updated home has plenty of space for relaxing and gathering. The main level features a primary bedroom, an open living and dining area, and a covered back porch perfect for outdoor meals and entertaining. Upstairs, there a second primary king bedroom and two additional guest bedrooms.

There's also a cozy living area with a twin daybed with a twin trundle. WaterColor Resort is a 499-acre coastal haven bordered by the Gulf of Mexico, a dune lake, and a serene pine forest. Its beautifully designed grounds include winding trails, parks, green spaces, pools, and playgrounds. Enjoy tennis courts, local boutiques, restaurants, and private beach access along Scenic 30A. Explore five miles of biking and walking trails, Western Lake’s boathouse with paddleboard, kayak, and canoe rentals, plus playgrounds and climbing structures for the kids. Fitness classes and basketball courts add even more to the lineup of activities. For golf cart rentals, reservations must be made through the community’s exclusive vendor, Electric Cart Company. Blue Oyster Cottage combines thoughtful design and a prime location for a memorable WaterColor vacation. Enjoy! Overview: - Centrally located in Watercolor Cottage District - 6-seater golf cart - All community pools heated seasonally - Wifi - Walk to tennis courts - Walk to Seaside town center – backs up to Seaside Tennis Courts - 4 adult bikes - Newly renovated kitchen and laundry room - Large covered front and back porch - Parking for two vehicles in the driveway Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, tub/shower combo SECOND FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, tub/shower combo - Guest Bedroom: King bed, shared hall bath, tub/shower combo - Bunk Room: Two twin over twin bunk beds, shared hall bathroom, tub/shower combo - Common Space: Twin daybed with twin trundle Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
